back_cover_blurb: Agents don't just answer. They do the work.
An AI agent reads, decides, uses tools and checks its own results. This book teaches you to build agents that are useful, safe and reliable, with Claude and the Claude Agent SDK.

You will build nine real agents for one small business, from a pantry helper to ShopMate, a back-office agent taken all the way to production. Every agent was run for real, and every result in the book was checked by code.
- The agent loop, tools, and structured outputs
- Inbox, receipt, research and data agents
- A support desk with guardrails in code
- MCP servers and teams of agents
